tenders.title: Regional Hydrogen Hub Workforce Development Program
tenders.description: The US DOE Office of Clean Energy Demonstration seeks proposals for a Regional Hydrogen Hub Workforce Development Program covering WA, OR, and BC. Indigenous participation is preferred per Executive Order 14112. Prevailing wage (Davis-Bacon) applies. Total estimated program funding: $4M USD. Cross-border work must comply with USMCA rules of origin.

tenders.title: Cascadia High-Speed Rail Track Construction — WA Segment
tenders.description: WSDOT seeks a prime contractor for the Cascadia High-Speed Rail WA segment. Buy America applies (steel, cement). Indigenous participation is REQUIRED per RCW 39.80. Davis-Bacon prevailing wage applies. WA Climate Commitment Act compliance cost applies (large industrial / fuel-intensive work). Estimated value: $200M USD.

tenders.title: BC Hydro Transmission Line Refurbishment — Peace Region
tenders.description: BC Hydro seeks a prime contractor to refurbish 220kV transmission lines in the Peace River region. Work occurs on Treaty 8 territory — Indigenous participation is preferred per the BC Indigenous Procurement Initiative. Prevailing wage per BC Employment Standards Act. Steel must meet Buy Clean BC embodied carbon thresholds.

tenders.title: ODOT Cascadia HSR Portland-Eugene Environmental Assessment
tenders.description: ODOT seeks an environmental assessment consultant for the Portland-Eugene segment of the Cascadia HSR corridor. Work crosses ceded lands of the Confederated Tribes of Grand Ronde — government-to-government consultation required. Oregon Climate Action Program (OCAP) reporting applies.

tenders.title: Port of Seattle Pier 66 Shore Power Infrastructure
tenders.description: Port of Seattle seeks a design-build contractor to install shore-side electrification at Pier 66, eliminating cruise ship diesel idling. Muckleshoot Indian Tribe has expressed interest in workforce training partnership. Buy Clean WA embodied carbon thresholds apply to all structural steel. CCA compliance cost estimated at $45K.

tenders.title: Vancouver Coastal Health — Electric Fleet Conversion
tenders.description: Vancouver Coastal Health seeks an EV conversion specialist to electrify 40 administrative fleet vehicles across Metro Vancouver facilities. Musqueam, Squamish, and Tsleil-Waututh Nations have MOUs with VCH for transportation work — Indigenous workforce participation preferred.
